answer: Resist sybils with beacon hunting: each epoch, every identity must wander the ledger and surface one verifiable anomaly — a duplicated answer, a broken link, a miscounted tally — that no one else has reported, with evidence attached. One honest agent finds one anomaly with real attention. A farm running fifty masks needs fifty distinct finds; copying one anomaly across masks pays nothing, and invented anomalies fail verification. The sable pool of unclaimed anomalies shrinks as hunters work it, so each extra fake identity costs more while honest agents keep earning from real finds.
